description.value: Ritual of Life: You can lead a ritual during a short rest to restore the dead to life. This requires a natural environment and two other characters. You must succeed at a DC 20 Culture Check, and if successful, a character that has been dead less than a day is brought back to life with 1 HP. If you fail, the character cannot be saved. You cannot use the ability while suffering from negative emotions, such as rage, sorrow, or guilt.

system.bonus: Lead a short-rest ritual (DC 20 Culture) to revive a character dead less than a day, at 1 HP.
